scope: Renewed Hunters' Circle interaction audit; eight new tests, no runtime or catalog changes
rules_covered: One shared Unit/Gear allowance in either order, for each player and physical field. Zero-Energy Deploy gear consumes it.
Hiding is not Play. A later free Hidden Unit play consumes the allowance, while another field retains its own.
Both players regain the allowance on their own turn. A Hidden play on the opponent's turn has no Circle modifier and does not consume the next turn's allowance.
Actual unit and Deploy-gear Moves do not consume the allowance. Cost quotations and cancelled or failed payments leave history unchanged. Completed finalization consumes it.
An instructed free Temporal Breach replay counts at its actual destination, creating a new unit object.
Core 356.1.b, 356.2.b, 356.4.d/f and 356.6: Hidden ignores base cost; Accelerate adds costs; Circle reduces total Energy to zero while matching Power remains.
Existing tests retain token-play consumption, lack of a control requirement, off-turn exclusion and no invented Deploy permission.
fixture_corrections: Cost-plan Energy is u32 while the resource view is u16; comparison now widens the resource value.
Starting the fixture in seat 1 channels runes. Clear those before setting an exact generated-Energy balance.
Command: Attack chooses a Battlefield target in its Move mode, not Action.lane.
The Hidden/Accelerate fixture supplies matching power after turn cleanup; the test legend does not provide the Cub's rune domain.
limitations: Controlled cross-domain fixtures validate rules interactions, not legal deck construction.
No new card, preset, AI strength or interface feature is claimed.
No new whole-suite test total is claimed; the published base separately records 1538 Rust tests and 254 catalog/source tests.
Only the named interactions were renewed; this is not complete Standard certification.
